title: Quantum Adaptation of the Six-Round Grøstl-256 Output-Transformation Approach
summary: The existing six-round Grøstl-256 approach faces precomputation beyond the Grover-search budget; adapting it into a quantum attack without that cost remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether the existing six-round Grøstl-256 output-transformation approach can be adapted into a quantum attack without a $2^{128}$-time precomputation. The approach requires memory of size $2^{128}$, and in the quantum setting a precomputation of that duration already exceeds the time limit set by Grover search.

scope.domain: Quantum meet-in-the-middle cryptanalysis of the six-round Grøstl-256 output transformation.
parameters: Six rounds: scope of the targeted Grøstl-256 output transformation
2^128: required memory size and prohibitive precomputation time
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether the existing approach can be adapted into a quantum attack without a 2^128-time precomputation.

citations.label: Simplified MITM Modeling for Permutations: New (Quantum) Attacks

progress.summary: The source explicitly states that it is unknown whether the existing approach can lead to a quantum attack. It identifies the 2^128 memory requirement and unaffordable 2^128-time precomputation relative to Grover search as the barrier.
citation_labels: André Schrottenloher et al., Simplified MITM Modeling for Permutations: New (Quantum) Attacks
